title: Monic and epic comparison morphism for finite quotient origin transport
statement: For core origin data C, an étale chart Z, a supplied constant model E on Z, and a pro-étale refinement W, the comparison construction from the constant realization of E to the pulled-back complex K admits a morphism that is both monic and epic.

source.place: Tag 09C6, comparison construction and local finite-model detection

proof.text: Restrict the core comparison to Z, compose with the supplied constant-model isomorphism, and pull the resulting morphism to W. The comparison-pullback coherence and the canonical finite-coefficient scalar comparison identify its source with constantAdicQuotientRealization and its target with the displayed pullback of K.

The local finite lisse models supplied by C.refinementLisse detect monomorphisms and epimorphisms after a covering restriction. Exactness of restriction and the sheaf epimorphism/monomorphism criteria descend these two properties to the global comparison morphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09C6, local comparison and finite-model detection

theorem lisse_finite_quotient_etale_origin_transport_map
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ X}
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] {d : AdicCoefficientDatum A} {n : ℕ}
    {K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n)))}
    {V : Y.Etale}
    (C : LisseFiniteQuotientEtaleOriginCore X Y g d n K V)
    (Z : V.left.Etale)
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))))
    (hE : Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.upperStar _ Z.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        C.level ≅ (constantSheaf Z.left.smallEtaleTopology _).mapDerivedCategory.obj E))
    (W : Y.ProEt) (_w : W ⟶ (toProEt Y).obj (Etale.mk (Z.hom ≫ V.hom))) :
    ∃ f : (constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ⟶
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
        ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj K,
      Mono f ∧ Epi f
